# Barlow Semi Condensed: the keys' letters

`port/gs/shared/key_letters_data.h` holds pictures of the letters printed on the keyboard's keys
(`port/gs/shared/button_pictures.h`, the Keyboard button style), drawn from `BarlowSemiCondensed-SemiBold.ttf` by
`tools/make_key_letters.py`. The font is from https://github.com/google/fonts (`ofl/barlowsemicondensed`), unchanged.

SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). Barlow is © 2017 The Barlow Project Authors (https://github.com/jpt/barlow).
